claims.claim: Samsonite collaborated with KU Leuven materials engineers on prototypes in 2004 and commercial launch in 2008 of self-reinforced polypropylene composite shells using Curv material.
claims.episode_span: such as the Curv material developed at KU Leuven in 2004 prototypes and commercialized by Samsonite in 2008
claims.source_title: On a journey with materials science — KU Leuven
claims.supporting_quote: The first prototypes were made here in Leuven in 2004.

claims.claim: Globe-Trotter has used a patented vulcanised fibreboard process since 1902 for hand-moulded suitcase shells.
claims.episode_span: Globe-Trotter’s vulcanised fibreboard process, hand-moulded since 1902 from compressed pulp layers
claims.source_title: Vulcanised Fibreboard: Our Secret Weapon — Globe-Trotter
claims.supporting_quote: Globe-Trotter patented the use of vulcan fibre in 1902 and is the only company in the world to use it in this way.

claims.claim: A 2013 patent by Xiangxing describes a co-extrusion and vacuum-forming process for multi-layer ABS/PC hard-shell luggage cases with an added PC film layer.
claims.episode_span: sometimes with a thin PC film co-extruded for surface protection, as described in the 2013 Xiangxing patent
claims.source_title: CN103407165B - A kind of manufacture method of ABS/PC duricrust casing
claims.supporting_quote: at the head end of the co-extrusion die of the injection molding machine, Another PC film is attached to the surface of the PC sheet layer on the surface layer
